Question: The data set \([6, 19, 33, 33, 39,\) \(41,\) \(41,\) \(43,\) \(51,\) \(57]\) has median \(Q_2 = 40,\) first quartile \(Q_1 = 33,\) and third quartile \(Q_3 = 43.\) An outlier in a data set is a value that is more than \(1.5\) times the interquartile range below the first quartile \((Q_1)\) or more than \(1.5\) times the interquartile range above the third quartile \((Q_3),\) where the interquartile range is defined as \(Q_3 - Q_1.\) How many outliers does this data set have?
